meaning: release evidence proves that an exact, verified source commit was built, published by digest and attested; it is never an authorization to apply, deploy or activate anything

pull-request-preflight.purpose: prove build, publish, digest, SBOM and provenance capability on the pull-request head before merge

protected-main-source-candidate.purpose: the authoritative candidate every staging and production promotion must reuse byte-for-byte

staging-certified.purpose: the same candidate bound to a completed isolated staging certification

production.purpose: the same candidate bound to the production promotion record

source_sha.rule: 40 lowercase hex; equals the checked-out commit that produced the evidence (or the certified source on promotion stages)

source_tree.rule: 40 lowercase hex git tree of source_sha

commit_verification_status.rule: one of G, U, VERIFIED (GitHub-verified signature) on every promotable stage; pull-request-preflight may additionally record UNVERIFIED_PREFLIGHT_HEAD because a pull-request head is not GitHub-signed

standby_auth_image_tag.rule: stage tag policy: preflight-sha-<source_sha> on pull-request-preflight, sha-<source_sha> otherwise; never a mutable tag

standby_auth_image_digest.rule: sha256:<64 hex>; equals the digest re-read from the registry after publication

standby_auth_sbom_sha256.rule: 64 hex sha256 of standby-sbom.spdx.json extracted from the published image's SBOM attestation

standby_auth_provenance_sha256.rule: 64 hex sha256 of standby-provenance.json extracted from the published image's provenance attestation

manifest_generation_id.rule: MIGRATION_MANIFEST manifest_generation_id of the exact tree

middleware_contract_sha256.rule: 64 hex; the Middleware public API route contract digest pinned by config/kong-canonical-middleware-routes.json

workflow_run_id.rule: positive integer GITHUB_RUN_ID of the producing run

workflow_ref.rule: GITHUB_WORKFLOW_REF of the producing run; must start with registryContract.repository.fullName + '/.github/workflows/'

staging_certification.rule: NOT_RUN_SOURCE_CANDIDATE on pull-request-preflight and protected-main-source-candidate; PASS:<certified source_sha>:<identity> on promotion stages

failClosed: any required binding absent, null, UNRESOLVED or malformed
standby_auth_image not equal to the registry contract image
a mutable or preflight tag on a promotable stage
an SBOM or provenance digest that does not match the extracted attestation file
